source: RFC 7748 (Langley, Hamburg, Turner, January 2016), https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7748 -- fetched live from https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7748.txt on 2026-09-10 and cross-checked byte-for-byte against x25519-dalek 2.0.1's own vendored test vectors (tests/x25519_tests.rs, functions rfc7748_ladder_test1_vectorset1/vectorset2 and the #[ignore] rfc7748_ladder_test2 iterated vectors), found locally at %CARGO_HOME%/registry/src/*/x25519-dalek-2.0.1/tests/x25519_tests.rs.
note: All fields are lowercase hex, no 0x prefix. 'x25519_scalar_mult' cases are RFC 7748 section 5.2 (Test Vectors): X25519(scalar, u) = output. 'x25519_iterated' cases are RFC 7748 section 5.2's second test-vector kind (repeatedly apply X25519 starting from k=u=9). 'x25519_diffie_hellman' is RFC 7748 section 6.1's worked Curve25519 ECDH example (Alice/Bob), where each side computes X25519(their_private_key, 9) for their own public key and X25519(their_private_key, other_party_public_key) for the shared secret K.

x25519_iterated.note: Starting k = u = 9 (encoded as a single byte 0x09 followed by 31 zero bytes). For each iteration: k' = X25519(k, u); u' = k; (k, u) = (k', u'). The final k after N iterations is 'output'.

cases.skip_reason: 1,000,000 sequential X25519 operations; too slow for a default test run (RFC 7748 marks this vector optional; x25519-dalek gates its own copy behind #[ignore] for the same reason).

x25519_diffie_hellman.note: RFC 7748 section 6.1: Alice and Bob each compute X25519(their_private_key, 9) for their public key, exchange public keys, then each compute X25519(own_private_key, other_public_key) to arrive at the same shared secret K.
